# Welcome to Ledgerly Discussions

## 🎯 Purpose

This forum is for discussing Ledgerly, a data-driven analytics workspace prototype. Use the categories below to organize your thoughts.

## 📋 Categories

### 💡 Ideas

Share and discuss new features, improvements, and creative uses of Ledgerly.

### ❓ Questions

Ask questions about using Ledgerly, getting started, or troubleshooting.

### 🐛 Bug Reports

Report bugs and issues found while using Ledgerly.

### 📦 Showcase

Share your analyses, dashboards, or creative projects built with Ledgerly.

## 🛠️ Getting Started

- Check the [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) for planned features
- Review the [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) for recent changes
- Visit the [Documentation](docs/design-system.md) for design guidelines

## 💬 Participation Guidelines

- Be respectful and constructive
- Search before posting to avoid duplicates
- Tag relevant contributors or teams when appropriate
- Keep discussions focused on Ledgerly
